component.name: QHealth
component.summary: Offline screen time and input activity tracker

description.p: QHealth records how long each application is actually used — time only counts while you are at the keyboard or mouse — and shows it as daily, weekly, monthly and yearly breakdowns. Everything stays in a local SQLite database; nothing leaves your computer.

ul.li: Per-app and per-website screen time with hourly and daily timelines
Keyboard and mouse heatmaps plus an activity calendar
Daily limits that can close an app once its allowance is used up
Focus sessions that only allow the apps you choose
A lightweight background service for KDE Plasma on Wayland and X11

description.p: Redesigned interface, much faster range switching, and installable packages.
